messages.author: 6ea789bedfb0caf8
messages.subject: Integrating GCP from images
parts:
Hello Dr. Matias, 

It was fun to watch some of the presentations during the Open Drone Data Processing Interest Group meeting this morning. 

Is there a way in FIELDImageR to standardize (correct, re-align?) GPS coordinates between orthomosaics based upon physical GCPs? 

I believe someone presented a solution to this in a different package and if it is implemented (or is going to be implemented) in FIELDImageR it would save me a heck of amount of time pointing and clicking the individual images.

Max

messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: Re: Integrating GCP from images
parts:
Hi Max,
Thank you for your feedback..!!!

That's a great idea. 
Right now, if you don't want rotating the image to use "fieldShape" (https://github.com/OpenDroneMap/FIELDimageR#P5) you can:

1) Use the function "fieldPolygon" (https://github.com/OpenDroneMap/FIELDimageR#P15);

2) Use the pipeline from UAStools presented today at Open Drone data (https://github.com/andersst91/UAStools);

3) Import shape file from other software for example QGIS using the package "rgdal" (https://github.com/OpenDroneMap/FIELDimageR#P20).

I will work in some better solution for your question. 
I believe integrate platforms is a really great idea.

Thank you for contacting,
Filipe Matias

messages.author: 6ea789bedfb0caf8
messages.subject: Re: Integrating GCP from images
parts:
I think the problem I am having is that the UTM coordinates between orthomosaics of the same field are slightly off set due to noise/error during data collection or construction of the orthomosaic in Pix4DFields. Unfortunately, I cannot input GCP coordinates in Pix4DFields so I'm stuck with coordinate estimates.

I didn't see any solution to this issue in Steve Anderson's UAStools tutorial.
https://github.com/andersst91/UAStools/wiki/plotshpcreate.R

I agree that saving a shape file with coordinates for each plot is the solution, but if the coordinates of the same point in reality doesn't match the coordinates between the orthomosaic files this strategy won't work. 

Maybe if orthomosaic construction solutions from Open Drone Map allow for GCP input it makes sense to use that solution instead of Pix4DFields. 🤷‍♂️
